result.topic_en: Notes on linear fractional (Möbius) substitutions between variables and how the derivative and square-root expressions transform under $z \mapsto \frac{az+b}{cz+d}$.
result.transcription:
$\mathfrak{z} \mid z_1\, z_2\, z_3$
$\eta_1\, \eta_2\, \eta_3$
$(\eta,\mathfrak{z})$. $\quad \begin{matrix}\mathfrak{z} \mp \mathfrak{z}' \\ \eta \mp \eta'\end{matrix} \Big| \; -\frac{z-p}{r} \mp \frac{r}{z'-p'}$
$(\eta_1,\mathfrak{z})$. $\quad \begin{matrix}\mathfrak{z} \mp \mathfrak{z}' \\ \eta \mp \eta'\end{matrix} \Big| \; \frac{z-p_1}{r_1} \mp \frac{r_1}{z'-p'_1}$
$z_{ii}$[?] $\quad \frac{\mathfrak{z} \mp \mathfrak{z}'}{\eta \mp \eta'} \Big| \; \frac{z-p_2}{r_2} \mp \frac{r_2}{z'-p'_2}$
$[-\mathfrak{z}-]\, z \mp \frac{az+b}{cz+d}$
$\frac{\partial z}{\partial \mathfrak{z}} \mp \frac{ad-bc}{(cz+d)^2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial \mathfrak{z}}$
$\frac{1}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial \mathfrak{z}}}} \mp \frac{1}{\sqrt{ad-bc}}\, c\, \frac{z}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial \mathfrak{z}}}} + d\, \frac{1}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial \mathfrak{z}}}}$
$\frac{z}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial \mathfrak{z}}}} \mp \frac{1}{\sqrt{ad-bc}}\Big(a\, \frac{z}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial \mathfrak{z}}}} + b\, \frac{1}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial \mathfrak{z}}}}$

methods.what: Substitutions between variables given by linear fractional maps involving poles p and radii r (inversion-type relations)
Transformation of $1/\sqrt{dz/d\mathfrak{z}}$ under a Möbius map: it transforms linearly together with $z/\sqrt{dz/d\mathfrak{z}}$
